text:
maria: Quick intake for Nimbus-12B perf onboarding — OSS checkpoint. Need a fast sanity sweep (latency + throughput + quick quant) before we greenlight for next-week demo. Priority: high. Please run batch & ctx sweeps, int8/int4 smoke, and a small quality delta check.

josh: sounds good. what's the concrete SLO and client shapes we should aim for?

maria: target p95 < 250ms for single-request path (batch=1, ctx=512) on A100-40GB. Throughput goal: ~1200 tokens/s for batch=8, ctx=512. Soft targets but useful to triage regressions.

anya: I'll pick this up. Proposed bench checklist:
- smoke runs: fp16, int8
- batch sweep: [1,2,4,8,16]
- ctx sweep: [128,512,1024,2048]
- quant profiles to try: llm.int8, awq-int4 (if conversion available)
- datasets: 1k short convo prompts + 500 long-form completions for throughput
- quality checks: 200 prompt subset for automatic metrics + human spot checks
- warmup: 200 tokens pre-measure per worker to fill KV cache and JIT

josh: add that we capture p50,p95, tokens/sec, mem peak, and tail allocation spikes. Also collect system GPU util and NVLink stats.

bench-bot: queued job 2149991113 for maria/nimbus-12b-smoke.

bench-bot: planned command:
```
run_bench --model nimbus-12b --devices a100:1 --quant int8,fp16 --batches 1,2,4,8,16 --ctx 128,512,1024,2048 --warmup 200 --metrics p50,p95,tokens_per_sec,mem_peak,gpu_util --out /artifacts/2149991113
```

anya: I'll open PR with the bench config (json + runner) under infra/bench/configs/nimbus-12b.json and tag @maria @josh for review.

oliver: small heads-up: Nimbus uses a slightly different tokenizer; normalize inputs with trunk_preproc or results will be noisy. Also watch the stop-token behavior on long completions.

maria: good catch — add tokenization normalization step to preproc and include the tokenizer version in results metadata. Also run embed-drift on 2k samples and a likelihood-drop test on the 200 prompt subset for regression signals.

josh: decision rule proposal: if int8 improves throughput with <=2% automatic-metric degradation vs fp16 (on the 200-subset), then promote int8. Otherwise keep fp16 + caching.

anya: full sweep estimate: ~3h on one A100 for all combinations, maybe 5-6h if retries/quant conversions fail. Starting now.

bench-bot: job 2149991113 started on infer-22, ETA ~3h. Logs and live dashboard: https://internal.corp/bench/2149991113

maria: perfect. please paste final CSV table (batch,ctx,quant,p50,p95,tokens_s,mem) and short notes on any anomalies back in this thread when done. :smile:

anya: will do. ping me if you want a quick live review during the run.
